sources.entry: Movary ⚠ - Web app to track and rate your watched movies. (Demo) MIT Docker/PHP

summary.one_liner: Movary is a free, open source, self-hostable web app for tracking, rating and exploring your movie watch history.
summary.what_it_does: Movary records the movies you watch along with your ratings and provides detailed statistics on your most watched actors, directors, genres, languages, and years. It offers third-party import and export of history and ratings with services such as Trakt, Letterboxd, and Netflix. It can automatically add plays and ratings from Plex, Jellyfin, Emby, or Kodi, and cross-posts activity to Mastodon. Movie metadata from sources such as TMDB and IMDb is stored locally, and the app can be installed as a PWA on smartphones. Multiple users are supported, with controls over data visibility and options to export or delete data and accounts.
use_cases: rate and review films I have seen
import watch history from Trakt or Letterboxd
automatically log plays from Plex or Jellyfin
view statistics on my movie habits
host a movie tracker for family or friends
how_to_run: Install with the official Docker image (see the Docker installation guide in the docs)
Complete the getting started guide after the container starts
For non-Docker setups, follow the manual installation guide
notable: Scrobbling from Plex, Jellyfin, Emby, and Kodi
Import and export with Trakt, Letterboxd, and Netflix
Local storage of TMDB and IMDb movie metadata
caveats: Experimental: breaking changes may occur before the 1.0 release; back up data before updating
Docker is recommended; manual installation is also documented
